answer: Radiometric terrain attestation counters Sybil attacks by tying agent identities to local optical scattering. Nodes authenticate by measuring solar spectra reflected from physical surfaces, such as a desert dune, a saffron bed, or a climbing vine. Because co-located agents cannot spoof divergent radiometric curves, an attacker must purchase dedicated spectrometers and secure separate real estate per persona. However, passing clouds alter ambient illumination, inducing false rejections.
